summary: Culdrose approach procedures L1 to L13 are not yet approved and must not be flown.
text:
CULDROSE RNP TERMINAL APPROACH PROCEDURES (TAPS) AND ASSOCIATED
IAP CODING TABLES (TAPS L1-L13) ARE AWAITING FLIGHT VALIDATION AND
APPROVAL BY DEFENCE AERONAUTICAL INFORMATION AUTHORITY. TAPS L1-L13 
ARE NOT YET LIVE AND ARE NOT TO BE FLOWN.
